items.prompt:
Natural selection favors organisms that are:
A) Better suited to their environment
B) Always the largest
C) Always the smallest
D) Identical
items.answer: A) Better suited to their environment

steps: Better-suited organisms survive and reproduce more.

items.prompt:
For natural selection to act, a population must have:
A) No differences
B) Genetic variation
C) Only one individual
D) No offspring

steps: Selection acts on genetic variation among individuals.

items.prompt:
On dark tree bark, which beetles are better hidden from birds?
A) Light beetles
B) Dark beetles
C) All beetles equally
D) No beetles

steps: Dark beetles blend in on dark bark.

items.prompt:
Over many generations on dark bark, the dark beetles will likely:
A) Disappear
B) Become more common
C) Stay exactly equal to light beetles
D) Turn into birds

steps: Dark beetles survive and reproduce more, so they increase.

items.prompt:
Why does a helpful trait spread through a population over time?
A) It is chosen on purpose
B) Individuals with it reproduce more and pass it on
C) It appears in every individual at once
D) It cannot be inherited
items.answer: B) Individuals with it reproduce more and pass it on

steps: More offspring inherit the helpful trait each generation.

items.prompt:
Why is genetic variation necessary for natural selection?
A) Selection needs differences to favor some individuals
B) Variation stops reproduction
C) Variation is harmful
D) It is not necessary
items.answer: A) Selection needs differences to favor some individuals

steps: Without variation, no individual has an advantage to select.

items.prompt:
A trait that helps beetles hide on dark bark would be LEAST helpful if the environment changed to:
A) A dark forest
B) Light-colored sand
C) Night with no light
D) A dark cave

steps: On light sand, dark beetles would stand out, removing the advantage.

items.prompt:
Which statement best describes how natural selection works?
A) Organisms choose to develop traits they need
B) The environment selects which existing varied traits survive and reproduce
C) All traits are equally passed on
D) Traits appear only from practice
items.answer: B) The environment selects which existing varied traits survive and reproduce

steps: Selection acts on existing variation; the environment favors some traits.
